name: BAT OVHT
description: Battery overtemperature (above 70°C). BAT on Warning Unit and audio tone, BAT OVERHEAT on Master List, voice message "BATTERY OVERHEAT".

procedure.heading: On ground:
procedure.text:
1. BAT MSTR sw — OFF (BAT DISCONN will appear)
2. Engines — Shut down

procedure.heading: In flight:
procedure.text:
1. BAT MSTR sw — OFF (BAT DISCONN will appear)
2. LAND AS SOON AS POSSIBLE
After landing:
3. Engines — Leave running in IDLE
If EPU available: 4. EPU — Connect, 5. BAT MSTR sw — ON, 6. Engine shutdown — Perform
If EPU not available: 4. Engine shutdown — Perform
Battery must be inspected or replaced prior to next flight.
